description: This file defines the StreamDeliveryFailureEntity class, which represents a delivery failure record in Azure Table Storage for Orleans streaming. It includes properties for identifying the failure, methods for setting keys and serializing/deserializing sequence tokens, and a static method for generating reverse timestamp ticks for ordering.

classes.name: StreamDeliveryFailureEntity
classes.description: Represents a delivery failure record stored in Azure Table Storage, with methods to manage keys and sequence tokens.

methods.name: SetPartitionKey
methods.description: Sets the PartitionKey property based on stream provider name and deployment ID.

methods.name: MakeDefaultPartitionKey
methods.description: Generates a default partition key string using stream provider name and deployment ID.

methods.name: SetRowkey
methods.description: Sets the RowKey property with a reverse timestamp and a new GUID.

methods.name: SetSequenceToken
methods.description: Serializes a StreamSequenceToken into the SequenceToken byte array.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Deserializes the SequenceToken byte array back into a StreamSequenceToken object.

methods.name: ReverseOrderTimestampTicks
methods.description: Calculates a long value representing the number of ticks from now to the year 9683, used for ordering.
